svg.aria-label: How it works. 1. Post one photo a day: Camera only. One picture from you, each day. 2. Unlock everyone’s: Their photos stay blurred until you post yours. 3. Keep the streak together: The group shares one streak. Show up, and it grows. 4. Encrypted photos: Photos are end-to-end encrypted, and they stay. The huddle is your shared album. Sign in with Apple, Groups of 2–8, Camera only, End-to-end encrypted photos, iPhone · iOS 17+.
